svg.title: Zoom changes framing; moving changes near-to-far size relationships
svg.desc: Zoom changes framing; moving changes near-to-far size relationships. Native ideal perspective projections of two abstract objects. No lens distortion, camera photograph or numerical focal-length claim. Row 3 moves closer using row 1 focal scale; row 2 stays in row 1 position and doubles focal scale. Light editorial presentation: fixed white paper, regular Helvetica labels, fine charcoal lines and restrained green accents.
